I'm of two minds on this. One, I'm a single veteran with several combat deployments where some of the biggest support groups were either started or contacted by military spouses. For that alone, I try to reciprocate as much in the way of manners and respect that I can muster. Most of that particular group deserves it, whether I know them or not.

That being said, far too many spouses have become caricatures of the person they once were or could have been, and it is depressingly not at all uncommon to see military spouses in the >50 BMI range. Additionally, the accompanying sense of entitlement is unreal, as is the voluntary shit-tier lifestyle in which they choose to engage.
